title: GTK2 palette refresh notification and user runtime deployment

method.gtk2: GTK 2.24.33 native mapped top-level in a separate process
method.gtk3: GTK 3 native mapped top-level in a separate process, concurrent with GTK2
method.gtk_theme_name: IrixClassic-KDE retained in private ~/.gtkrc-2.0 across a palette refresh
method.runtime_install: Transactional user bundle install; final package adds/updates four targeted GTK2 modules. Two DomainOS renderer modules were required because the already-installed GTK2 RC references disabled arrow pixmaps absent from the older companion catalog.

result.native_reload_tests: 3/3 passed, including no DISPLAY refusal, GTK2 event delivery, and GTK3 control survival/interactivity
result.gtk2_reload_event_order: synchronizer calls the notifier only after the GTK2 palette transaction returns native_reload_required
result.startup_reconciliation: synchronized; DomainOS GTK2 palette unchanged; no reload event emitted

limits: The first runtime restart exposed a stale renderer/catalog mismatch: the installed DomainOS GTK2 RC referenced disabled arrow pixmaps unsupported by the prior companion. That failed attempt was preserved in the installation backup; the final staged renderer modules now support the installed names and a read-only dry refresh returned unchanged.
Tests ran on private Xvfb and synthetic palette fixtures; no user color scheme was switched.
GTKSettings:gtk-theme-name stayed constant during broadcast. A real XSettings manager Net/ThemeName transition and an open GTK2/XChat window were not available for live visual confirmation.
GTK3 remained functional when the global GTK2 reload broadcast was sent; this does not certify every GTK version or toolkit.
No Domain/OS VM received input; no historical visual or human acceptance was recorded.
next: After this receipt and queue update, have the user test one real GTK2/XWayland application with a palette change; do not touch the VM without Q499 authorization.
progress_estimate: I484 implementation and private tests complete; live GTK2/XWayland visual acceptance remains pending. This is not the percentage of the full GTK2 or project goal.
